city_status.summary_en: Air quality in Belgrade is moderate; sensitive individuals may experience slight effects.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Ne mogu da prihvatim Observerovo prostorno uporište kao dokaz kretanja vozila: prikazani broj slobodnih mesta u Masarikovoj promenio se sa 61 na 278, ali izvor ne daje vreme merenja. Ni Connectorovo razlikovanje praznina u vremenskom toku ne utvrđuje njihove uzroke; prijem podataka o parkiranju pre 13 min datira prijem, a ne prikazano stanje. [F5][F4]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I cannot accept Observer’s location anchor as evidence of vehicle movement: Masarikova’s displayed free spaces changed from 61 to 278, but the feed supplies no measurement time [F5][F4]. Nor does Connector’s distinction between timeline gaps establish their causes; parking’s reception 13 min ago dates receipt, not the displayed conditions [F4].
questions_sr: Da li promena prikaza za Masarikovu može odražavati zakasnelo ažuriranje umesto kretanja vozila [F5][F4]?
